description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Loan installment schedule functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It defines multiple test cases verifying the distribution of loan repayment schedules under different interest types, interest calculation settings, and installment configurations.

classes.name: LoanInstallmentMultiplesOfTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying loan repayment schedule distributions based on different interest types, amortization methods, and installment configurations.

methods.name: interestTypes
methods.description: Provides different interest types for parameterized tests.

methods.name: test_LoanRepaymentScheduleIsEquallyDistributed_WhenNoInterest_ButInterestTypeIs
methods.description: Tests repayment schedule distribution when no interest is charged but interest type is specified.

methods.name: test_LoanRepaymentScheduleIsEquallyDistributed_WhenInterestIsPresent_AndInterestTypeIsFlat
methods.description: Tests repayment schedule when interest is flat and present.

methods.name: test_LoanRepaymentScheduleIsEquallyDistributed_WhenInterestIsPresent_AndInterestTypeIsFlat_AndMultiplesOfIs20
methods.description: Tests repayment schedule with interest type flat, interest interest rate multiples of 20, and specific installment configurations.
